customSections.label: Students Are Out March 17–26, Not Just for Spring Break
customSections.content: Students are out of school March 17–26. The stretch begins with a grading and staff-development day on March 17, spring conferences on March 18, and another no-school day on March 19, followed by Spring Break March 22–26. Classes resume Monday, March 29.

customSections.label: November 30 Is a Student-Free Day
customSections.content: SKPS uses two labels for November 30. The live calendar says “No School – Grading Day,” while the family PDF says “Professional Development/District Directed.” Both sources mark it as a student-free day.

customSections.label: SKPS Has Not Published Specific Emergency Make-Up Dates
customSections.content: The family calendar says days may be added in June after emergency closures but does not identify reserved dates. The scheduled last days remain June 16 for grades K–5 and June 17 for grades 6–11 unless SKPS announces a change. Because the ICS file is a one-time download, any make-up day announced later will not be added automatically.

customSections.label: Middle School Trimesters and High School Semesters
customSections.content: Middle schools use trimesters, while high schools use semesters. The dates below apply only to the school level shown.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Salem-Keizer Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 6 and 9 begin Tuesday, September 8, 2026. Grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–12 begin Wednesday, September 9. Kindergarten follows a later transition schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Salem-Keizer kindergarten start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten transition is September 14–15, and all kindergarten students begin Wednesday, September 16. Follow the school-provided transition schedule for the first two dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Salem-Keizer Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a professional-development day, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Salem-Keizer Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 22–26, 2027. Students are also out March 17–19 for a grading and staff-development day, spring conferences, and a separate no-school day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Salem-Keizer Public Schools in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades K–5 finish Wednesday, June 16, 2027. Grades 6–11 finish Thursday, June 17. SKPS may add June instructional days after emergency closures.

calendarFaqs.q: Are October 28–30 regular school days in Salem-Keizer?
calendarFaqs.a: No. October 28–29 are no-school fall-conference days, and October 30 is a separate no-school day. Students have three consecutive weekdays without regular classes.

calendarFaqs.q: Does SKPS publish translated family calendars?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The 2026–27 family key-date calendar is available in English, Arabic, Chuukese, Russian, Spanish, and Swahili.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Salem-Keizer emergency make-up dates already scheduled?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The family calendar says days may be added in June after emergency closures but does not identify specific reserved dates. Wait for an SKPS announcement before treating another June date as a school day.

sourceReviewSummary: Verified August 9, 2026, against the live SKPS calendar page and the complete English family key-date PDF. The PDF was rendered and checked visually, and the five official translation links were recorded from the district calendar page.
sourceReviewDetails: The English family PDF is one page and marked REV 6/2026. It was rendered because shaded and half-shaded cells distinguish student-free dates.
The live calendar and PDF agree on the grade-specific openings, kindergarten transition, breaks, graduation window, and grade-level last days.
The live calendar calls November 30 a grading day; the PDF calls it Professional Development/District Directed. Both mark it as a student-free day.
Return dates after Thanksgiving, Winter Break, and Spring Break are calculated from the published student-free and staff dates.
The family calendar does not list specific emergency make-up dates; it only says days may be added in June.
Individual schools may publish additional key dates, transition assignments, bell times, and graduation details.
